title: Grateful Dead Live at Henry J. Kaiser Convention Center on 1986-12-30
lineage: mac > nak dragon tape deck > creative extigy soundcard > cooledit pro > flac frontend
source: nak 300 mics w/cp4 shotguns > sony d-5 > mac

ai_review.summary: A solid audience recording that captures a rejuvenated Garcia and an upbeat show, sounding clearer than most crowd tapes.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers praise the performance, noting Jerry Garcia's refreshed vocals and the band's growing confidence throughout the set. The tape is described as a good‑sounding audience recording that stands out among other crowd sources, offering a raw yet enjoyable listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: High reviewer scores (5 and 4) and enthusiastic comments about both the music and tape quality indicate a strong show with decent recording clarity, though only two reviews limit certainty.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clearer than typical crowd tapes; good overall balance with a raw garage‑band vibe, no major dropouts reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert is described as an uplifting, exploratory set where the band builds confidence step by step, highlighted by Garcia's refreshed vocal performance.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia's voice sounded rejuvenated and confident.
